review_candidates.title: Market Development Director - Northeast Region
review_candidates.description: Since our founding in 2009, REGENXBIO has pioneered what’s possible in gene therapy. Today, we are advancing a pipeline of gene therapies designed to improve the lives of patients facing serious rare and retinal diseases and preparing to bring innovative new medicines to patients. Our work is fueled by purpose and urgency because every day matters to patients and their families. At REGENXBIO, you’ll find meaningful opportunities to grow, collaborate, and contribute to the advancement of potentially transformative gene therapies. Together, our talented team is working to make a meaningful difference for patients and their families. What We Do Matters. The opportunity As a Market Development Director, you will drive regional strategy and commercial launch readiness in support of our innovative therapies for rare and neuromuscular diseases. In this field-based leadership role, you'll lead strategic engagement with key stakeholders and treatment centers, ensuring regional alignment with REGENXBIO's broader go-to-market objectives. As a vital connection between internal teams, including Sales, Medical Affairs, Patient Services, Advocacy, Marketing, and Market Access—and external ecosystem partners, you'll shape and execute regional strategies that support treatment access and long-term market development for REGENXBIO's products. This is a field-based position supporting the Central U.S. Region. Candidates should reside within the assigned territory with the ability and willingness to travel regularly. What You'll Be Doing Develop and execute targeted engagement strategies for key accounts in assigned regions Establish REGENXBIO as a trusted partner in the neuromuscular and rare disease communities Lead regional business planning aligned with corporate goals and cross-functional priorities Collaborate with internal stakeholders to synthesize customer insights, inform strategic decisions, and optimize messaging and programs Ensure adequate resource allocation to drive regional business success Identify, educate and align thought leaders to our strategic imperatives while being accountable for pulling through brand initiatives with the thought leaders Profile treatment centers to assess readiness, patient care models, referral patterns, and logistical infrastructure Deliver education on REGENXBIO’s products, and tend to end treatment administration logistics Identify and address barriers to care, including infusion capacity, billing/coding challenges, and payer dynamics Support reimbursement readiness and validate regional processes for market access Cultivate strategic partnerships and referral networks to support launch and market expansion Define and track KPIs to measure launch execution quality and speed Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned treatment centers, experts, and stakeholders Drive brand awareness, engagement, and treatment adoption through innovative commercial strategies Monitor regional trends in the competitive, regulatory, and payer landscapes to inform strategy Champion a customer-first mindset and ensure execution reflects the needs of patients and providers It is imperative that REGENXBIO employees embody our core values by working collaboratively, building strong relationships and using clear communication to meet shared objectives What We’re Looking For Minimum of 5+ years in a commercial, market development, or strategic customer engagement role within biotech/pharma Bachelor’s degree required (BA/BS); advanced degree (MBA, PhD, PharmD) strongly preferred Proven track record in the rare disease space, ideally including neuromuscular indications Experience supporting new product launches in complex therapeutic areas Strong understanding of U.S. healthcare dynamics, market access, and reimbursement pathways Familiarity with account-based models and stakeholder mapping in specialty care Analytical thinker with the ability to extract insights from data and apply them to commercial decisions Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Strategic mindset with the ability to align cross-functional teams toward shared goals High ethical standards, integrity, and a mission-driven approach Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment Strong initiative and problem-solving capabilities Willingness and flexibility to travel up to 60% for stakeholder engagements Why should you apply? By joining REGENXBIO, you will have the opportunity to be a part of a growing company, with an incredible team, who is passionate about developing novel AAV gene therapies for patients in need. We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefit & compensation package which includes market-competitive salaries, an annual bonus program, education assistance, retirement plan with employer match, stock options at all levels, summer hours and more! The estimated compensation range for this role is $187,000 to $265,000 annually. The actual salary offered to the final candidate depends on a number of factors such as relevant work experience, skills, education, and years of experience. In addition, professional development is important to us. By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to be exposed to challenging projects and have access to development resources to help you grow personally and professionally.

review_candidates.title: Manager – Place-Based Resilience (Barcelona)
review_candidates.description: Location : Barcelona Metropolitan Area. Hybrid, mostly home-based, with on-site work across the Barcelona Metropolitan Area and some international travel. Applicants must live within regular traveling distance and have the right to work in Spain. Reports to : Lead – Resilience & Health Direct reports : None Contract : Open-ended contract through an Employer of Record; the program is funded until 2029. Full-time (40 hours/week) Salary : EUR 35,000–45,000 gross annually, depending on experience, plus benefits. Start date : As soon as possible. Closing date : Monday, 23 November 2026, 10:00 CET. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. About R-Cities R-Cities is a global network of cities, Chief Resilience Officers (CROs), and partners scaling urban resilience solutions. Embedded in city governments, CROs shape planning, investment, and action. Through R-Cities, they exchange approaches, test solutions, and connect city-led action with global investment. With over a decade of experience, we support more than 100 cities in over 40 countries to adapt and thrive. R-Cities operates through a US 501(c)(3) nonprofit and a Netherlands-based Stichting. About The Team Resilience for Communities (R4C), R-Cities' largest program, turns resilience into local action. In neighborhoods in Boston, Houston, Greater Manchester, Melaka, and now Barcelona, we work side by side with residents, local partners, and city governments. Together we assess climate risks, co-design solutions, and deliver change, from cooler public spaces to stronger community networks. R4C is part of the Urban Climate Resilience Program (UCRP), a global initiative of the Z Zurich Foundation delivered with partners including C40, ICLEI, IFRC, and Plan International across ten countries. This combines local delivery with learning from a global community of practitioners. R4C sits at the heart of R-Cities' new strategy, which sees place-based resilience as a key pathway to scale and puts people and their well‑being at the center of resilience practice. You'll join a small international team sharing lessons across cities. In Barcelona, the program works at both community and metropolitan level with the Àrea Metropolitana de Barcelona (AMB), so what we learn in two communities can shape resilience planning for more than three million people. The role R4C Barcelona is a three-year program backed by the Z Zurich Foundation, Zurich Spain, and other partners, which helps communities in the Barcelona Metropolitan Area prepare for climate risks such as extreme heat and flooding. You’ll get the program off the ground together with the Lead – Resilience & Health. That means building trust with communities and local partners, finding where the work can plug into city and metropolitan policy to reach scale, and turning resilience assessments and co-design into changes people can see and feel in their neighborhoods. You’ll keep it running smoothly: plans, partners, workshops, monitoring and reporting, and a highly engaged Zurich Spain team and its volunteers. Barcelona is also where R-Cities will test what comes next. Heat is a health risk as much as a climate one, and this program is a chance to show that resilience pays off in people's lives, in communities that are healthier, more connected, and happier. You’ll help build that evidence and shape how R-Cities grows locally led resilience work centered on people, equity, health, and well‑being. The role suits someone who enjoys building new work and managing delivery details. What you will do Program delivery and coordination (25%) Owns: Program plans, delivery trackers, milestones, and action logs across both sites, kept current and accurate. Delivery against agreed deadlines, with risks to timelines identified and escalated early. Program meetings, including scheduling, agendas, papers, minutes, and follow-up. Program records and shared systems, including Airtable, kept up to date. Contributes To: Program planning, the inception phase, and annual work plans and budgets owned by the Lead. Selection of communities and local implementation partners, led by the Lead. Partners and communities (25%) Owns: Day-to-day coordination of local implementation partners, including onboarding and operational administration at both sites. Monitoring of partner delivery against agreed specifications, work plans, and timelines, with issues raised early. Coordination of community resilience assessments and action planning, together with partners, including logistics, facilitation, and follow-up. Design, facilitation, and follow-up of workshops and community engagement, with particular attention to reaching groups that are less represented in formal processes. Application of safeguarding, data protection, and informed consent procedures in community activities, including work with schools and young people. Contributes To: Relationships with the AMB, participating municipalities, the City of Barcelona, and other institutional partners, owned by the Lead. Design and delivery of community resilience interventions with municipalities, schools, and partners, including permits, procurement, and long‑term maintenance arrangements. Support for local and community‑based organizations to raise funds and attract further investment, so that resilience work can continue beyond the program. Partner capability building across the Place‑based Resilience portfolio, sharing what works in Barcelona with other R4C cities. Monitoring, evaluation, and funder reporting (20%) Owns: Coordination of monitoring, evaluation, and learning data, including baseline data, partner data returns, and impact data for the Z Zurich Foundation. The quality, completeness, and timeliness of program data, with consent and data protection requirements met. Assembly of funder reports and Steering Committee updates, including inputs, deadlines, and supporting documentation. Contributes To: Funder relationships and reporting narrative, owned by the Lead. Community Baseline Reports and Community Action Plans. The program's monitoring, evaluation, and learning framework and external program reviews or evaluation. Facilitation, events, and corporate engagement (20%) Facilitation, events, and corporate engagement (20%) Owns: Day-to-day coordination with Zurich Spain's Corporate Responsibility team, including the engagement plan agreed during inception and regular progress updates. Employee volunteering: designing activities with partners and communities so that they respond to community priorities, briefing volunteers, delivery on the day, and follow‑up. End‑to‑end delivery of launches, community events, and learning visits, including logistics and on‑site coordination. Collection of stories, quotes, photos, and other material for program communications, with appropriate consent. Contributes To: Zurich Spain's technical contributions and the engagement of its customers, brokers, and business partners. Program communications, coordinated by R-Cities' communications team. Policy, knowledge, and fundraising (10%) Owns: Discrete workstreams and improvement initiatives assigned to the role[1.1], taken forward with limited supervision. Contributes To: Policy and knowledge products at local, national, and global levels, including research, drafting, and production. Fundraising for the program and the wider portfolio, including proposals and supporting materials. Percentages are indicative and may change as the role develops. What you bring You're excited about urban resilience and about building it from the ground up, together with communities. You can hold a program together operationally and also run a room, with credibility in front of residents, partners, and corporate volunteers. You build trust and lasting relationships with community organizations and local government alike, and you're at ease moving between the two. You communicate clearly in writing and in person, take ownership of your work, and prioritize well. You have a problem‑solving mindset and an appetite to grow into wider responsibility, and you're comfortable in a fast‑paced, distributed organization. A bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as economics, political science, sociology, geography, architecture, business administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. A minimum of four years of professional experience, including at least two years managing or coordinating programs or projects with several stakeholders. Experience coordinating delivery by funded or subcontracted partners, including monitoring progress against agreed plans, deliverables, and timelines. Experience working with communities and local government or public institutions, with the ability to build trust, facilitate participation, and navigate competing priorities. Facilitation experience, including designing and leading workshops or community sessions. Experience with monitoring and evaluation and data collection. Experience producing written reports for funders or senior stakeholders. Based within regular traveling distance of Barcelona and able to work on site, with the right to work in Spain. Fluency in Spanish and professional fluency in English. A master's degree in a relevant field. Experience planning and running professional events end to end, including logistics and delivery on the day. Experience working with Barcelona's communities, institutions, or delivery landscape. Experience delivering community development, regeneration, resilience, climate, health, or public sector programs. Experience directly contributing to funding bids or proposals. Experience with funder reporting or grant compliance. Experience contributing to policy or knowledge products. Working knowledge of Catalan.

review_candidates.title: Ingénieur calcul génie civil - ADF F/H
review_candidates.description: Contribuer à relever les défis actuels et futurs pour préserver notre monde et construire celui de demain tout en prenant soin de la santé de chacun, c'est stimulant pour vous. Pour nous aussi. En rejoignant le groupe Orano, acteur international de référence dans le nucléaire, vous êtes au bon endroit. Chaque jour nous nous mobilisons pour produire une énergie bas carbone efficace, pour lutter contre le réchauffement climatique, pour trouver des solutions économes en ressources naturelles et participer au progrès en matière de santé. Nos atouts ? Sur l'ensemble du cycle du combustible : une grande maîtrise des technologies de pointe, des produits et services sûrs et à forte valeur ajoutée, des expertises pointues et une grande capacité d'innovation. Autant d'arguments qui révèlent les fortes compétences de nos 18 000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices que nous veillons à faire évoluer constamment. Riches de leur différence en termes de profils ou d'expériences, preuve de notre ouverture à tous les talents; ils partagent la même ambition : donner toute sa valeur au nucléaire. Si vous êtes passionné par les défis complexes du génie civil et que vous souhaitez faire partie d'une équipe innovante chez Orano ADF, cette offre est faite pour vous. À Propos D'Orano ADF Orano ADF repousse constamment les limites de l'ingénierie nucléaire, œuvrant pour un avenir énergétique durable. Rejoignez notre équipe dynamique où l'innovation et l'excellence sont les maîtres mots. Votre Mission En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) Calcul Génie Civil, vous serez le moteur de la conception et de la vérification des structures nucléaires chez Orano ADF. De la réalisation de calculs sophistiqués à la présentation des résultats aux clients et aux autorités de sûreté nucléaire, votre rôle sera crucial. Ce Qui Vous Attend Défiez les Forces de la Nature : Vous aurez la responsabilité de dimensionner les ouvrages nucléaires face aux éléments les plus extrêmes, du séisme aux tornades, en passant par le vent et la neige. Maîtrisez les Calculs Avancés : Mettez en œuvre des méthodes de calcul avancées pour répondre aux exigences uniques des installations nucléaires. Imprégnez-vous de l'Immersion: Travailler au sein de notre équipe génie civil chez Orano ADF vous offrira une véritable immersion dans la culture d'entreprise et une compréhension approfondie du métier. Soyez un Soutien Technique éclairé: Agissez en tant que soutien technique auprès des équipes Orano lors des phases FAISABILITES à REAL, démontrant ainsi votre expertise inégalée. Pourquoi Nous Rejoindre Chez Orano ADF En plus d'intégrer une équipe dynamique et innovante chez Orano Projets, vous bénéficierez d'avantages exceptionnels, d'opportunités de formation continue et de l'occasion de laisser votre empreinte sur des projets nucléaires de renommée mondiale. Si vous êtes prêt(e) à être au cœur de l'action, à contribuer à l'évolution de l'ingénierie nucléaire chez Orano ADF et à faire partie d'une équipe exceptionnelle, Votre Profil Expert Confirmé Vous êtes un professionnel aguerri avec plus de 10 ans d'expérience en calcul génie civil, issu d'un cycle ingénieur ou d'une formation universitaire équivalente en Génie Civil ou Calcul des Structures. Passion pour le Calcul Complexe : Vous êtes motivé(e) et désirez vous développer dans le monde stimulant du calcul complexe des structures génie civil. Compétences Rédactionnelles Votre capacité à rédiger des notes de calcul impeccables est incontestable. Esprit Analytique Et Rigueur Vous identifiez les risques, faites preuve d'un esprit d'analyse aiguisé et d'une rigueur inébranlable dans chaque tâche que vous entreprenez. Opérateur international reconnu dans le domaine des matières nucléaires, Orano apporte des solutions aux défis actuels et futurs, dans l’énergie et la santé. Son expertise ainsi que la maîtrise des technologies de pointe permettent à Orano de proposer à ses clients des produits et services à forte valeur ajoutée sur l’ensemble du cycle du combustible. Grâce à leurs compétences, leur exigence en matière de sûreté et de sécurité et leur recherche constante d’innovation, l’ensemble des 18 000 collaborateurs du groupe s'engage pour développer des savoir-faire de transformation et de maîtrise des matières nucléaires, pour le climat, pour la santé et pour un monde économe en ressources, aujourd’hui et demain. Orano, donnons toute sa valeur au nucléaire. EN SAVOIR PLUS SUR NOUS

review_candidates.title: INGENIERO PREVENTA DATA CENTER, NETWORKING E INTEGRACIÓN
review_candidates.description: Quito | Tiempo completo | Disponibilidad de visitas a nivel nacional Buscamos un Ing de Soluciones capaz de diseñar, dimensionar y sustentar soluciones integrales de alta complejidad para Data Centers, seguridad electrónica y redes convergentes. Responsabilidades Clave Analizar requerimientos complejos, pliegos y términos de referencia para proyectos integrales. Diseñar arquitecturas de red avanzadas (ej. Spine-Leaf) garantizando alta disponibilidad y baja latencia. Dimensionar matemáticamente infraestructura crítica (cálculo de oversubscription, presupuestos ópticos, rendimiento de firewalls NGFW y almacenamiento RAID). Diseñar soluciones de integración de plataformas VMS/BMS con motores de Inteligencia Artificial. Estructurar el Costo Total de Propiedad (TCO), incluyendo proyecciones de licenciamiento OPEX y crecimiento de almacenamiento. Defender técnica y comercialmente las arquitecturas propuestas ante clientes, justificando el valor frente a topologías tradicionales. Conocimientos Técnicos Indispensables A diferencia de perfiles tradicionales, esta posición requiere dominio comprobable en las siguientes áreas de arquitectura: Centro de Datos de Redes y Datos: Diseño de topologías Spine-Leaf, protocolos VXLAN/EVPN, y alta disponibilidad (MLAG/vPC). Ciberseguridad y Perímetro: Dimensionamiento de Firewalls NGFW (throughput real activo-activo/activo-pasivo), microsegmentación y ciberseguridad OT (802.1X, Zero Trust). Almacenamiento (almacenamiento): Cálculo exacto de IOPS, retención de video, y arreglos RAID (ej. RAID 6/60) para plataformas críticas. Sistemas de Seguridad Integrados: Arquitectura de plataformas VMS/PSIM (Genetec, Milestone, Avigilon o similares), analíticas de video edge/server-side con GPU, y protocolos de integración (ONVIF, BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP). Infraestructura Física: Cálculo de presupuestos ópticos (power budget) para fibra monomodo/multimodo, y selección de transceptores/cables DAC/AOC. Requisitos del Perfil Título de 3er nivel en Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica, Sistemas, TI o afines. Mínimo 2 años de experiencia comprobable en infraestructura tecnológica de misión crítica. Mínimo 2 años de experiencia directa como Ingeniero de Preventa, Arquitecto de Soluciones o Consultor Técnico. Capacidad demostrada para realizar cálculos de dimensionamiento técnico sin depender exclusivamente de herramientas automatizadas de fabricantes. Deseable: Certificaciones técnicas vigentes en marcas líderes de Networking, Seguridad o VMS serán altamente valoradas. Sobre el Proceso de Selección: El proceso incluye una prueba técnica avanzada (150-180 minutos) que evaluará el cálculo manual de capacidades, diseño de redes convergentes, y justificación de arquitectura. Abstenerse si no cuenta con experiencia en diseño integral de Data Centers y Networking.
